# T1 — Define the settings struct

## Spec

A single struct holding every runtime setting, with a `Default` implementation
matching today's hardcoded values.

## Scope

`src/settings.rs` only. No caller changes — wiring is T2.1's job.

## Acceptance

- The struct exists, is documented, and round-trips through serialization.
- `Default` reproduces the current hardcoded values exactly.

Struct landed with defaults matching the constants it replaces. Nothing calls it
yet; T2.1 is the first real caller.
